item.title: Whataburger tops list for best-value burgers, research shows
item.description: Whataburger has been named the best-value fast-food burger chain in the US, offering the largest patty at the lowest price per ounce of meat, according to a new study by NetCredit.

item.title: Fort Worth's United Way Institute boosts local nonprofits
item.description: The United Way Institute in Fort Worth is launching a new regional hub this spring to help the 42% of local households struggling to afford basic needs, by providing access to new technology, research and innovation to strengthen the area's nonprofit sector.

item.title: Astra Kitchen + Lounge debuts at Hall Arts Hotel in Dallas
item.description: ASTRA Kitchen + Lounge, a new dining concept at the HALL Arts Hotel, will open on March 4 with Executive Chef Miguel Antonio leading the kitchen and offering a menu of seasonal ingredients and elevated American comfort food.

item.title: Texas ranks 48th for women’s quality of life: WalletHub report
item.description: Texas was ranked 48th out of 50 states for women to live in, according to a report, which evaluated states based on 25 metrics.

item.title: Texas' luckiest street names for lottery wins, revealed
item.description: An analysis of lottery data has identified the luckiest street names in Texas.

item.title: Jason Kidd invests in Dallas Pulse women's volleyball team
item.description: Dallas PULSE, a professional women's volleyball team in Major League Volleyball, has secured strategic investments from Dallas Mavericks head coach and NBA Hall of Famer Jason Kidd, as well as other former professional athletes and business leaders, to help grow women's professional sports in North Texas.

item.title: Dickey's Barbecue Pit in Wylie celebrates grand re-opening deals
item.description: Dickey's Barbecue Pit in Wylie will host a grand re-opening celebration on March 7 to introduce new operator Shahrukh Siddiqui, featuring one-day barbecue specials and 22% off any meat plate.

item.title: Schlotzsky's rebrands with fresh design and classic roots
item.description: Schlotzsky's is rebranding to "Schlotzsky's Deli" and launching a new restaurant prototype designed to improve service speed and reduce costs.

item.title: Dallas developer Henry S. Miller III, West Village creator, dies at 86
item.description: Henry S. Miller III, a prominent Dallas developer and fourth-generation leader of the Miller real estate legacy, died on Feb. 28, 2026. Miller reshaped the Dallas urban landscape through the development of West Village and the stewardship of Highland Park Village.

item.title: Fort Worth Stock Show reveals 2026 BBQ pitmasters lineup
item.description: The Fort Worth Stock Show Syndicate has announced the 2026 BBQ Pitmasters lineup for the Syndicate Smokedown & Music Festival, featuring complimentary barbecue samplings, a music lineup featuring Whiskey Myers and the Randy Rogers Band, and a BBQ competition.
